source_lineage.pooling_rule: Unknown lineage is conservatively pooled into a single group rather than optimistically split. Lineage is established by verified mapping, never by distinct author lists, journals or PMIDs.

boundaries: Research-only. Not a clinical or diagnostic artifact.
No variant classification, ACMG criterion, VUS worklist or submission is authorized.
No panel membership exists, so no panel metric may be cited.
Gate 8 named human review remains blocked and the accepted-claim count is zero.
No RescueScreen result, compound, treatment, dose or combination claim.
content_sha256_basis: SHA-256 over the canonical JSON serialization of this record with the content_sha256 key removed: json.dumps(record, sort_keys=True, indent=2) encoded UTF-8 plus exactly one terminal LF, LF-only on every platform. Self-excluding: the hash field itself is never part of its own preimage.
contextually_adjudicable_dimensions: minimum number of independent laboratories or source lineages (P2)

diagnostic_counterfactual.finding: Removing the P2 established-source-group minimum alone left the problem infeasible, and removing the D3 assay-concentration cap alone left the problem infeasible. Feasible subsets appeared only when BOTH were removed together, so P2 and D3 interact rather than acting as independent binding constraints.
diagnostic_counterfactual.interpretation_limit: This is a diagnostic statement about which constraints bind, produced with full knowledge of the negative outcome. It is not a relaxation proposal, not an authorization to weaken P2 or D3, and not evidence that a panel exists. Weakening a constraint after seeing the answer is outcome-dependent constraint selection and remains prohibited by the frozen protocol and ADR-0017.
diagnostic_counterfactual.label: DIAGNOSTIC_POST_HOC_NOT_A_SELECTION

expert_adjudication.hard_limit: An expert may lower a claim ceiling and contextualize P2/D3/D2/C3. An expert may not transform dependent evidence into independent replication and may not waive any non-waivable dimension.
expert_adjudication.reachability_note: EXPERT_ADJUDICATED_RARE_DISEASE_PANEL is reachable only through a future named, signed decision record carrying every required field. No machine path and no document in this commit can reach it.

interpretation.evidence_packages_note: The individual Gate 1-7 evidence packages did not fail. What failed to exist was a panel-level configuration satisfying cross-lineage independence and assay diversity on the available substrate.
interpretation.original_result_validity: The 2026-08-06 result is valid and correct under its own preregistered independent-validation claim. Nothing about it is withdrawn.
interpretation.rare_disease_context: In an intrinsically sparse rare-disease literature, specialist-lab dominance is an expected property of the field rather than a defect of the reports. That context warrants a named expert adjudication of whether a lower-claim-ceiling panel is scientifically useful, rather than automatic rejection.
interpretation.scarcity_finding: The current specialist-led literature for this substrate cannot establish cross-lineage, assay-diverse independent validation: zero established lineage groups, two assay kinds with one dominant readout, and one broad model-system category.
what_this_does_not_do: It records, implies or anticipates no human approval.
It converts no dependent evidence into independent replication.
It authorizes no ACMG criterion, classification, worklist or submission.
It makes no RescueScreen, compound, treatment or clinical claim.

outcome_transition.genuine_downgrade: prospective_state moves from PROSPECTIVE_REGISTERED (v1.0.4) to POST_HOC (v2.0.0). The interpretation layer is weaker evidence than the run it describes.
outcome_transition.pairing_rule: The two outcomes are reported as a pair and neither is cited alone. The contextual outcome does not replace, supersede or soften the machine outcome.

post_hoc_note: Authored 2026-08-15, nine days after the run it describes and with full knowledge of its outcome. POST_HOC status is not removed by review, agreement or elapsed time; prospective activation requires a new registration frozen before the run it governs.

rubric.spec_sha256_basis: SHA-256 of the LF-normalized (committed-blob) spec bytes.

scarcity_direction_rule: Scarcity lowers claim ceilings. It never strengthens evidence, never upgrades an axis value and never makes a non-waivable dimension optional.

source_run.immutability_statement: This record reads the source run and copies aggregate facts from it. It does not edit, re-run, re-sign, re-hash, retract or supersede it. The source run remains published and citable in its own right.
source_run.sha256_basis: SHA-256 of the committed (LF) blob content. A Windows checkout with core.autocrlf=true expands line endings in the working copy, so a raw-byte hash of the working file differs by design; the committed-blob value is binding.

substrate_characterization.basis_note: The frozen run record carries the D1/D2/D3 thresholds and their infeasibility, not an assay-kind or model-system inventory. These three values are supplied by the readjudication task as a characterization of the eligible evidence and are labelled as such so they are never mistaken for verified run outputs.
